change_scope: repository governance, CI determinism, unified verification interface, and evidence classification. No runtime, application, database, or provider state is modified.

review_remediation.finding: the prepared branch-protection ruleset required contexts produced by path-filtered workflows
review_remediation.consequence: GitHub blocks a pull request until every required context reports; a path-filtered workflow never reports on a PR outside its paths, so a valid PR would have been permanently unmergeable
review_remediation.severity: would have caused a merge-path outage worse than the governance gap it closed
review_remediation.fix: required contexts are now restricted to workflows that run unconditionally on pull_request; capability-registry-gate and machine-gateway-namespace-isolation had their path filters removed; web-recovery-build and memory-evidence-intake are no longer required because pandora-verify already runs typecheck, build, and the Memory evidence intake contract on every PR
review_remediation.regression_guard: scripts/check_branch_protection_contexts.mjs parses the workflow files and fails on any required context that is path-filtered, unknown, ambiguous, or lacking a pull_request trigger; wired into npm run verify with 9 self-tests and 2 unit tests

enforcement.third_party_actions_pinned_to_sha: all except actions/setup-python, which could not be verified from this repository-scoped session and is deliberately left on a tag rather than falsely pinned

evidence_normalization.pr35_artifact_classified: MCP_GITHUB_ACTIONS_WRITE_2026-08-17.md recorded as production_verified for the narrow claim it makes, after the coverage gate caught it as unclassified
